topic: Copying session data for facility inventory
summary_markdown: The discussion centered on a technical task involving two specific facilities (tractor). These facilities were recently added to the inventory and linked to existing assets. The core requirement is to copy session data for these facilities, starting from 2024-10-01, specifically for Company 7930. This process involves creating virtual sessions because the required historical data does not currently exist in the system.
decisions: The recipient will copy session data for two specific facilities (tractor) for Company 7930.
action_items: Copy session data for the specified facilities and company, starting from 2024-10-01.
